name: @aico/ops
description: Host operations: aico deploy (a project's units from the exact commit it started on), aico logs, aico snapshots (Btrfs points) and aico vm (Proxmox guests through SummitFlow's VM route).

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --log-level=error --outfile=dist/aico-ops.mjs --banner:js="// Aico ops bundle. Built by npm run build; do not edit."
